entries.trap_note: 財務報表常用 miscellaneous expenses（雜支費用）。
entries.example: The finance department allocated a modest fund for miscellaneous stationery and catering expenses.

entries.collocations: face severe disciplinary action for violating privacy rules (因違反隱私法規面臨嚴厲懲處)
entries.trap_note: 常見搭配：disciplinary action / measures / penalty（紀律懲戒處分）。
entries.example: Any employee who shares proprietary source code will face immediate disciplinary proceedings.

entries.collocations: international trade delegation representing renewable energy (綠能國際貿易代表團)
entries.trap_note: 指代表團時為可數名詞；指「授權」時為不可數名詞（delegation of authority）。
entries.example: A senior commercial delegation will arrive tomorrow to discuss bilateral export agreements.

entries.collocations: small business proprietors affected by supply bottlenecks (受供應瓶頸衝擊的小企業主)
entries.trap_note: 單數為 proprietor；proprietorship 表獨資企業；與 landlord / owner 同義。
entries.example: Local shop proprietors formed an alliance to lobby for reduced municipal commercial taxes.

entries.collocations: promptly rectify the billing error on the final invoice (迅速修正發票帳務錯誤)
entries.trap_note: 正式商業書信動詞，rectify an error / mistake / situation。
entries.example: The billing department worked overtime to rectify the software glitch before issuing monthly invoices.

entries.meaning: 可以說、按理說、論證上（等於 reasonably）
entries.collocations: arguably the most innovative financial technology platform (可說是最新穎的金融科技平台)
entries.trap_note: 常用於修飾最高級形容詞（arguably the best / most effective）。
entries.example: The newly opened medical research facility is arguably the most advanced center of its kind in Asia.

entries.collocations: streamline global logistics management to lower shipping costs (精簡全球物流管理以降低運費)
entries.trap_note: 字尾恆有 s，指整個物流學科或運作體系時視為單數或複數，logistics hub（物流樞紐）。
entries.example: By consolidating warehousing hubs, the firm streamlined its overseas logistics network.

entries.meaning: 經由、透過、取道 (=by way of / by means of)
entries.collocations: official documents will be delivered via express courier (官方文件將透過快捷快遞遞送)
entries.trap_note: 介系詞，後接交通方式、通訊管道或中停地點（via email / via Frankfurt）。
entries.example: All confidential contract drafts should be transmitted via encrypted file transfer rather than regular email.

entries.meaning: 分支機構、業務部門、機構之分支
entries.collocations: the research arm of the multinational conglomerate (跨國企業集團之研發機構)
entries.trap_note: 商務偏義字！除了「手臂」外，多益常考「分支業務單位（an investigative / commercial arm）」。
entries.example: The commercial banking arm of the financial group recorded a thirty percent rise in net profits.

entries.collocations: a quiet residential suburb located outside the metropolis (位於大都市外的寧靜住宅郊區)
entries.trap_note: 形容詞為 suburban（郊區的）；in the suburbs 表「在郊區居住」。
entries.example: Many families choose to live in the green suburbs and commute into the financial center by light rail.

entries.meaning: 更不用說、何況 (專用於否定遞進)
entries.collocations: The firm cannot afford rent, let alone purchase equipment (公司連房租都付不起，更不用說買設備)
entries.trap_note: 重要文法片語！出現在否定句或表缺乏（lack / barely）之後，強調更不可能發生的情況。
entries.example: The cash-strapped startup could barely afford office rent, let alone hire full-time legal counsel.

entries.meaning: 深思熟慮的、明智知情的；見多識廣的
entries.collocations: consult an advisor to make an informed financial decision (諮詢顧問以做出明智知情的財務決策)
entries.trap_note: 多益必考搭配詞：make an informed decision / choice。informative 則是形容事物提供豐富資訊。
entries.example: Consumers are encouraged to consult certified financial planners before making an informed investment decision.

entries.meaning: 多樣的、各式各樣的、形形色色的
entries.collocations: a varied selection of imported specialty coffees (多樣化的進口特調咖啡選品)
entries.trap_note: 修飾單數集合名詞 selection / assortment 時用 varied；various 則直接修飾複數名詞。
entries.example: The international food market offers a varied selection of organic cheeses and artisanal breads.

entries.meaning: 反對的、抗拒的 (固定搭配介系詞 to)
entries.collocations: Community leaders are firmly opposed to the commercial zoning (社區領袖強烈反對商業分區)
entries.trap_note: 固定搭配：be opposed to + N / V-ing（to 為介系詞）。主動 oppose 則直接接受詞。
entries.example: Several neighborhood associations are firmly opposed to the proposed industrial zoning expansion.

entries.meaning: 長期的、持久的、被拖長的
entries.collocations: prolonged droughts (長期乾旱) ｜ prolonged negotiations (持久談判)
entries.trap_note: 由過去分詞轉化之形容詞，修飾談判、延遲或乾旱等持續很久的事件。
entries.example: Following prolonged negotiations, the two pharmaceutical giants finally agreed on the merger terms.

entries.collocations: principal objective of the marketing campaign (行銷活動之核心首要目標)
entries.trap_note: 商務名詞表「目標」（primary / principal objective）；作形容詞表「客觀的」（objective analysis）。
entries.example: The primary objective of the corporate restructuring is to accelerate product development cycles.
